bacterial_leaf_blight.cause: Bacterial infection associated with Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.
management: Use resistant rice varieties where available.
Maintain field drainage and avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
Consult local agricultural experts for region-appropriate control measures.

brown_spot.cause: Fungal disease caused by Bipolaris oryzae.
management: Use healthy seeds and suitable resistant varieties.
Seek local agricultural advice if the disease is spreading.

blast.cause: Fungal disease caused by Magnaporthe oryzae.
management: Use resistant varieties suitable for the region.
Consult local agricultural experts about appropriate disease management.

normal.cause: No obvious disease symptoms detected visually.
management: Maintain balanced irrigation and crop nutrition.
